vibecode.title: Vibecode key
vibecode.description: Used by Insights to read your Bitrix24 data. Create a read-only personal key and paste it below. It is stored encrypted and never shown again.
vibecode.statusNone: No key configured. Insights runs in lean mode.
vibecode.revoked: Vibecode rejected the stored key (revoked or invalid). Register a new key.
vibecode.loadError: Could not load the key status.
vibecode.adminOnly: Only administrators can manage the Vibecode key.
